review.official:
Estelle, her infection only at a moderate stage, attracted attention due to mutations triggered by
Oripathy
. She later sought medical asylum at
Rhodes Island
after trying several other treatment programs.
She received psychological counseling and a battery of examinations with her consent before officially joining Rhodes Island as a guard with a squad of
operators
.

files.description:
Imaging tests for this Operator showed blurry outlines of internal organs with visible dark spots. Unusually high concentrations of Originium particles were present in her circulatory system, indicating infection and confirming her as Infected at this stage. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 16% 
Severe mutation following infection, sprouting horns noncharacteristic to the race. Close observation recommended. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.31u/L 
Infection entering mid-stage, tests required to discern specific effects. 

[Mutation Assessment] 
Based on current observations of Archosauria, double horns are not an expected racial trait. According to Operator Estelle's own account, she has never had any manifestation of biological mutations growing up. Thus, the mutated horns are determined to be caused by Oripathy.

Operator Estelle is habitually nervous and self-restrained, constantly in a state of unease, though most Operators have paid little attention to her state of mind. Estelle's two mutant horns are the primary cause of her worried behavior. 
In the past, Estelle has slipped into depression over the mutation and withdrawn from all social activity. It is advised that the Doctor provide further psychological counseling to prevent total self-isolation.

Despite her typical baseline level of anxiety, Estelle has never appeared nervous in battle. Observations have shown that she retains her Archosaurian warrior spirit, as is present in Gavial, a fellow Archosaurian. Estelle possesses remarkable melee combat abilities, employing her own body as her primary weapon. Her enormous horns and powerful tail have won her many a victory, as she charges mightily ahead, driven by bestial instinct. 
Her fellow operators have stood in awe of her ferocity. To which Estelle responds with uncharacteristic withdrawal, opting for solo combat and giving her teammates a wide berth, focusing only on her commander's orders.

Currently, Rhodes Island has established a series of special arrangements for Operator Estelle, including psychological evaluation and disease management. Due to Estelle's expression of a strong desire to recover, it is best to avoid explaining the situation to her for the time being. 
Based upon current medical technology, the prospects of containing Estelle's Oripathy are more realistic. Monitoring of the patient's psychological condition has shown that she is more willing to 'accept the disease as a part of her and live in a non-human form,' which is a positive development. However, it is possible that this will be a source of instability in the future. 
Based upon this assessment, the relevant personnel will must continue to evaluate and adjust their methods in order to actively guide Estelle to proper self-acknowledgement.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Uh... w-where should I stand? O-oh, you want me to sit? Then... where should I sit?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: That little bird is my friend. But it's always disappearing on me these days... Oh no... It's not disliking me, is it...

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: The way I look... is nothing like an Operator at all... And I understand having someone like me in your team won't make you pround... But don't worry, I won't go around saying I'm with Rhodes Island.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: You've probably noticed, but my hair is quite difficult to style... So I have to let my hair down like this... It's not very appropriate, is it?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: My mutant horns... they don't really fit in with the crowd... I thought I was used to other people staring at them... but … but it's still embarrassing...

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: The friends I made in the wilderness... they're all coming to Rhodes Island too. So... I'll feel less lonely. I'll do my best to fight hard and protect everyone.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Actually, ever since my childhood, I've always been dreaming to be a... a princess... I-I mean it's okay if you find it ridiculous...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: The bad guys always call me 'freak'... but… yeah, I'm a freak, a freak that wants to protect you and everyone else.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Um... that really energetic doctor... she's an Archosaurian too, huh? I do want to talk to her... but I'm still a bit scared…

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: No one's staring at me now, right? Ah, finally...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: H-hello... Uh... s-sorry, my horns... I accidentally broke your office door with my horns...

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Powers stronger than what I already have... can I really control them...?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Promotion? What's that?... I don't really get it, but I think it means that I've been helpful, right?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Thank you, Doctor, for giving me a bit more confidence... Now I am starting to understand what to do and how to wield my power.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: P-please don't look at me...

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Wahh... me? R-really? Is that really okay?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Uh, everyone... it's... it's time to attack! I-is this how I'm supposed to give orders?

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I... I won't let the bad guys win!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Huh? Me?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Let me do it!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: My pushover look should pull a lot of enemies here...

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: To intimidate the enemy... I... I'm capable of that, right?

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Hah!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: I-I won't let you pass!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I won't let you escape this easily!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Fear me, please!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: I can do better... yes, even better!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Are you proud of what we've achieved, Doctor?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Great... we won, Doctor!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: In the end... I'm good for nothing... just as expected...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Wow, this place... it's so spacious! I love it!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Um...

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: You're always so kind to me... I... I'm so happy!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor... My wish is to get along better with everyone. Will I be able to do that? And make more friends as well... is that allowed? Having friends...

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: D-Doctor...

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, this is a gift I made... My friend on my head shed a bunch of feathers, which I made into a pendant. I hope you like it...

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Fighting makes me feel useful... You've always thought so? T-Thanks, Doctor... And outside of battle as well? I... Gavial and Tomimi said so too? Am I... dreaming?
